which redis-cli; ls /opt/redis-7.2/bin; redis-cli -p 6379 info server | head -20; redis-cli -p 6380 info server | head -12; redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication
for p in 6379 6380; do redis-cli -p $p config get databases; redis-cli -p $p config get maxmemory*; redis-cli -p $p config get replica-read-only; done; redis-cli -p 6380 config get appendonly
redis-cli -p 6380 replicaof 127.0.0.1 6379; sleep 5; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | head -12; tail -5 /var/log/redis/redis.log
redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep -E 'offset|slave0'; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep offset; redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace

redis-cli -p 6380 replicaof no one; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | head -3; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep connected_slaves
cat > /tmp/cmp.sh <<'EOF'
diffs=0
for db in 0 2; do
  for k in $(redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db --scan); do
    t1=$(redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db type "$k"); t2=$(redis-cli -p 6380 -n $db type "$k")
    d1=$(redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db dump "$k" | md5sum); 
    p1=$(redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db pttl "$k"); p2=$(redis-cli -p 6380 -n $db pttl "$k")
    dt=$(( p1>p2 ? p1-p2 : p2-p1 ))
    if [ "$t1" != "$t2" ] || [ $dt -gt 5000 ]; then echo "DIFF db$db $k $t1/$t2 $p1/$p2"; diffs=$((diffs+1)); fi
    if [ "$t1" = stream ]; then
      g1=$(redis-cli -p 6379 -n $db xinfo groups "$k"); g2=$(redis-cli -p 6380 -n $db xinfo groups "$k")
      [ "$g1" != "$g2" ] && { echo "GROUPDIFF $k"; diffs=$((diffs+1)); }
    fi
  done
done
echo diffs=$diffs
EOF
bash /tmp/cmp.sh | tail -5
k=events:06; for p in 6379 6380; do echo "== $p"; redis-cli -p $p xinfo stream $k full > /tmp/s$p.txt; done; diff /tmp/s6379.txt /tmp/s6380.txt | head -40

for k in $(redis-cli -p 6379 --scan --pattern 'events:*'); do for p in 6379 6380; do redis-cli -p $p xinfo stream $k full | awk '/^(radix-tree-nodes|radix-tree-keys|idmp-duration|idmp-maxsize|pids-tracked|iids-tracked|iids-added|iids-duplicates|nacked-count)$/{getline; next} {print}' > /tmp/f$p; done; cmp -s /tmp/f6379 /tmp/f6380 && echo "same $k" || echo "DIFF $k"; done | sort | uniq -c | head; redis-cli -p 6379 --scan --pattern 'events:*' | wc -l
